description: Trainable parameter counts for GigaPath-DefGNN vs the matched GAT baseline. Frozen Prov-GigaPath ViT-G encoder (requires_grad=False) excluded. Generated by scripts/16_param_counts.py.

delta_deformable_minus_gat.note: Manuscript (v0.12, corrected) states ~1.32M total, ~445K GAT, ~+875K overhead — consistent with these counts. The implemented DeformableAttentionLayer does NOT extend a GAT base: it uses independent q_proj + kv_proj_static + kv_proj_sampled + out_proj + skip projections per layer. The OffsetMLP is only ~6.7K; the bulk of the +874648 overhead is the three large input projections (each 1536->.. in layer 1) and the skip projection, not a single extra k/v head.
